reuse.why: Holidays are threaded into the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend for the move case, but no shared 'non-business day' predicate is created or reused for the daily-skip case.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday predicate is written four times: two local isNonBusinessDay lambdas in server/schedules/app.ts, skipsDailyNonBusinessDay in getNextDate, and inline in getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

placement.why: The moving rule lives in the shared util as it should, but the daily-skip holiday check is re-defined locally inside each server handler.

scope.why: Focused on holidays, though getNextDate also switches from value.schedule.data to dateCond.value for the existing weekend flags, an incidental rewiring.

maintainability.why: Any change to what counts as a holiday (such as the later MM-DD rule) must be repeated in four places, and the take-size heuristics are scattered.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts define their own isNonBusinessDay lambdas instead of using a shared definition in shared/schedules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The same weekend-or-holiday test appears under different names and shapes: isNonBusinessDay (twice, app.ts), skipsDailyNonBusinessDay (getNextDate) and a while condition in getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

one_place.where: The holiday rule is defined separately in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.
